summary: A coworker organizer asks lots of questions and ends with a direct request to sign, come, or join.
realLife: A union training guide says an organizing conversation differs from others in that it ends with an ask, such as joining a meeting, signing a petition, or walking out.
sources: UAW, How to Have an Organizing Conversation (union training guide): https://uaw.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/How-to-Have-an-Organzing-Conversation-FINAL.pdf
inGame: a coworker tie plus a cause shared leading to an invitation; needs: unions as organizations and petitions

turns.summary: The coworker complains alongside and never asks for anything.
The coworker asks to sign in the first minute.
turns.writesBack: the other pulls back; a tie dip

turns.summary: The coworker asks and names a day to check back.
turns.writesBack: a kept follow-up; a tie rises
